stemMd: Which event creates new combinations of alleles on a chromosome during normal meiosis?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Translation of one messenger RNA by several ribosomes

options.label: C
options.textMd: Crossing over between nonsister chromatids of homologous chromosomes

options.label: D
options.textMd: Separation of identical DNA strands without replication

explanationMd: Homologous chromosomes pair in prophase I. Corresponding DNA segments can be exchanged between their nonsister chromatids, creating combinations different from either original parental chromosome. This recombination is distinct from the independent assortment of whole homologous pairs.

distractorRationale.d: This does not describe meiotic recombination.
distractorRationale.b: Ribosomes do not exchange chromosome segments this way.
distractorRationale.e: Normal meiosis preserves one set for each gamete.
distractorRationale.a: Translation produces proteins and does not recombine chromosomal alleles.
